findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas used inconsistent and shortened Danish side labels instead of the established full terms.
evidence: The explanatory text used den modstående side and den tilstødende side while the formulas omitted side or used a different form.
findings.resolution: Aligned all three visible formulas with the established Danish side terminology.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas mixed Danish side labels, including the inconsistent modsat form.
evidence: The formulas varied between modsat, tilstødende, and den modstående instead of using the section's established full terms.
findings.resolution: Aligned all three inverse formulas with den modstående side and den tilstødende side.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used abbreviated side labels instead of the terms used in the Danish explanation.
evidence: The example labels omitted side while the explanatory text consistently used den modstående side and den tilstødende side.
findings.resolution: Expanded both example labels to the established Danish side terminology.
